title: AI Transparency Atlas: Framework, Scoring, and Real-Time Model Card Evaluation Pipeline

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not directly measure model bias; rather, it evaluates the transparency and completeness of bias documentation. It uses an automated multi-agent LLM pipeline to extract and score the presence and depth of "Fairness & Bias Evaluations" (such as the BBQ benchmark) reported in publicly available AI model cards and system documentation.
